content:
Sam: quick async check-in — microQ onboarding status
Alex: pulled the nightly evals; noticed 3 small regressions vs yesterday on summarization prompt set
Maria: which tests? can you paste the failing sample
Alex: failing samples: "order confirmation" summary compresses wrong entity (company -> client). short diff below
Alex: ```diff
- client: Acme Corp
+ company: Acme Corporation
``` 
Priya: hmm that looks like prompt tokenization difference from qkv quant. Did we change tokenizer in the quant conversion? 
Devon: I touched the tokenizer conversion script yesterday for sparse vocab pruning — PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/423
Sam: @Devon can you drop a quick note in the PR about downstream eval failures? need context for gating
Devon: will do, added a note and a hermetic repro in the PR
Sam: EvalBot, rerun nightly evals for microq-1.2? 
EvalBot: scheduled rerun: job 88192 queued on runners (ETA ~10m) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex: also seeing kv-cache warmup slower on Dedicated region eu-west-1 for this model — 75ms cold start instead of 30ms
Maria: any config diff between nodes? batching windows? 
Sam: config looks identical, but I saw a telemetry spike on batch_size=16 yesterday for microq-1.2
Priya: can we test with `batch_size=8` and `kv_prefetch=true`? quick command:
Priya: ```bash
tox -e smoke -- model=microq-1.2 --batch_size=8 --kv_prefetch=true
```
Alex: I'll run it locally and post logs
Alex: ran smoke, kv warmup 28ms with batch_size=8 — seems plausible
Sam: blockers: need a quick code review on PR 423 (tokenizer change) and someone to triage eval diffs if rerun still fails
Priya: I can review the tokenizer PR today, ping me in the PR
Devon: thanks, @Priya :thumbsup:
Sam: logistics: we'll hold the model onboarding gating until we clear the regressions or add prompt-specific overrides. If EvalBot rerun passes we can proceed with a soft canary
Alex: noted — I'll update the onboarding checklist + add a note about the dedicated kv warmup test
Maria: FYI, I put a small prompt tweak in the promptset repo to normalize "company"/"client" tokens — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/promptsets/commit/ab12cd
Sam: perfect. end of my check-in. ping me if you hit blockers or need infra help
Devon: thanks, signing off :wave:
